overall: Measured, cinematic public-radio delivery with quiet urgency. Begin in storm-dark restraint, build technical clarity through the mechanism, make the evidence limit candid rather than apologetic, and land the final line with unresolved resolve. Natural Texas intelligence, never a drawl, trailer voice, news-anchor read, or sales pitch. Keep the ten lines continuous with ordinary breaths only.

lines.text: When power, cell service and cloud go dark, this local flood node keeps thinking.
lines.intent: Open on the surprising survival of one small machine; grounded urgency.
lines.emphasis: cloud go dark; local flood node; keeps thinking

lines.text: Chen Pan's UT San Antonio team built the field-ready prototype.
lines.intent: Name the accountable source and builder cleanly.
lines.emphasis: Chen Pan's; UT San Antonio; field-ready

lines.text: Ambient light charges backup storage, keeping the node alive through storms and grid outages.
lines.intent: Make the power loop feel physical and practical.

lines.text: Four optical sensors track rising water beside weather readings.
lines.intent: Let the accumulating inputs accelerate without sounding like a list.

lines.text: Tiny ML evaluates current and recent signals on the node.
lines.intent: Deliver the technical core simply, pronouncing ML as the two letters M L.
lines.emphasis: Tiny ML; evaluates; on the node

lines.text: The first decision skips the distant server, cell tower and power line.
lines.intent: This is the decisive turn: remote dependencies fall away.

lines.text: Long Range radio sends data to a local central hub so emergency teams can monitor conditions.
lines.intent: Clarify that inference and communication are separate steps; Long Range is the expanded name of LoRa.
lines.emphasis: Long Range radio; local central hub; monitor conditions

lines.text: Here is the honest frame: a prototype, initial validation and no named installation site.
lines.intent: Turn from promise to evidence limit with confidence and candor.
lines.emphasis: honest frame; prototype; no named installation site

lines.text: The work ahead is weatherization and deployment beyond the lab.
lines.intent: Shift the measure of success from model score to field consequence.

lines.text: A local node matters only if its warning survives the flood.
lines.intent: Land the thesis without claiming field proof that does not exist.
lines.emphasis: local node; matters only if; warning survives
